name: bdapps-backend-manager
description: Shortcuts to easily manage all Bdapps microservices

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -k -n "API,AUTH,OTP,SMS,PROJ,SUB,ANAL,USSD" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue,red,white,gray" "cd api-gateway && npm run dev" "cd auth-service && npm run dev" "cd otp-service && npm run dev" "cd sms-service && npm run dev" "cd project-service && npm run dev" "cd subscription-service && npm run dev" "cd analytics-service && npm run dev" "cd ussd-service && npm start"
